paragraphs.notes: Markush enumeration table, compound numbers 341 to 367, continued from the preceding page: the page carries no Tabelle caption and no scaffold drawing, only the column header row and the rows. Subscripts and superscripts are printed as such (R7a, R7b, R12, R1 with superscript labels; MeSO2, EtSO2, PrSO2, PhSO2, 4-Me-PhSO2, PhC(O)CH2, OCH2CF3 with subscript digits); they are flattened to plain text here. The cells are chemical symbols, not German prose, so zh and en are the same string. The L column is CHMe in every row on this page. The R1 column changes value twice: row 341 is O-c-Bu, rows 342 to 365 are O-c-Pr, rows 366 and 367 are OCH2CF3. The R12 cell of row 361 is printed a little further right than the cells above and below it; the text is the same PhSO2. A small ink speck sits immediately above the O of O-c-Pr in row 342, a fainter one in the Nr. cell of row 342 and another in the Nr. cell of row 361; a single dot sits in the blank area below the table near the page centre. These are scan artifacts, not characters. No abbreviation key is printed on this page, so Bz, Pr, c-Bu and c-Pr are transcribed as printed and not expanded.
